problem.title: Two Sum
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; Chinese explanation independently paraphrased
facts: The same array element cannot be used twice.
Return the two indices in any order.
2 <= nums.length <= 10^4; values and target are within [-10^9, 10^9].

claims.claim: 开始处理下标 i 前，seen 记录 nums[0:i] 中已扫描值到下标的映射。
claims.validation: Loop invariant in article; solution checks before inserting the current value.

claims.claim: 每个元素只处理一次，哈希查询和插入期望 O(1)，因此期望时间 O(n)，最坏额外空间 O(n)。
claims.validation: Asymptotic analysis of the single pass and seen dictionary.

claims.claim: 若答案下标为 a < b，则处理 b 时补数 nums[a] 已在 seen；任何返回项的 seen 下标都小于当前 i，因此不会复用同一元素。
